blocks.arabic_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ نَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَنَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اسْتَعَاذَ مِنْهُ نَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنْتَ الْمُسْتَعَانُ وَعَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ
blocks.text:
remember them." Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Should I not teach you a du'aa that incorporates all of them?" Rasulullaah ﷺ then told them to recite:
"We ask You for every good that Your Nabi Muhammad ﷺ asked You for and we seek Your protection from everything that Your Nabi Muhammad ﷺ sought Your protection from. It is only from You that help can be sought and only You can conclude all matters because there is no power or might but from Allaah"[^1]
Factors from which Rasulullaah ﷺ used to Ask for Allaah's Protection

blocks.arabic_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Anas (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ used to make du'aa saying:
"O Allaah! I seek Your protection from helplessness, laziness, cowardice, extreme old age and miserliness. I also seek Your protection from punishment in the grave and from the tribulations of life and death"

Another narration adds the words:
"...(and I seek Your protection from) the burden of debts and the tyranny of men"[^2]

blocks.arabic_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَمِلْتُ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا لَمْ أَعْمَلْ
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ used to include the following words in his du'aa:
"O Allaah! I seek Your protection from the evil of what I do and from the evil of what I do not do"[^3]

blocks.arabic_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيْعِ سَخَطِكَ
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) narrates that amongst the du'aas that Rasulullaah ﷺ made was:
"O Allaah! I seek Your protection from losing Your bounties, from a reverse in well-being, from sudden calamities and from all forms of
Tirmidhi (Vol.2 Pg.190). Bukhaari has reported a similar narration in his Adab (Pg.99).
